legend: The Dover Demon (Dover, Massachusetts, USA, April 1977)
lines: Dover, Massachusetts, April nineteen seventy-seven, just after dark.
A teenager drives down a quiet country road.
In his headlights, something crawls along a stone wall.
It has a huge, melon-shaped head, thin limbs, and glowing orange eyes.
They say it has no nose and no mouth, and it is as small as a child.
Hours later, another teenager spots it standing in the bushes.
A sketch appears in the local paper, and the town can't stop talking.
No tracks, no photos, and no proof, only a drawing.
An animal, a hoax, or something else? What do you think?
title: The Dover Demon: The Creature With Glowing Orange Eyes #shorts
description:
In April 1977, a few teenagers in Dover, Massachusetts said they saw a strange creature with a huge head and glowing orange eyes. It was never found.
